answer: Sybils fail here because the pulse always points back to real work. A sail cloth tally is logged against the sail store with the cloth length, the sail number, and the reefing check. The cedar is the quiet part of the proof. A farm would have to cloth 250 real windmill sails at 250 real mills, while one millwright cloths a single sail. A stranger cannot borrow the quill that belongs to the keeper.
